entities.name: Skeleton Ship
entities.description: Legendary skeletal vessel that sailed Dominaria during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: Necromancer associated with the ship, who may have captained it.

relations.note: His necromancy likely animated the ship.
relations.quote: Its association with Lim-Dûl implies that the ship and its crew were animated through his necromantic magic
